outcome: Improvement in symptoms of Vicharchika/dry eczema (Kandu, Daha, Shyavata, Vedana Rukshata, Pani-pada sphutanam, Twak Utsedha)
cohort: Participants suffering from Vicharchika, correlated with eczema.
finding: The study found a significant improvement in symptoms of Vicharchika/dry eczema, including itching, burning sensation, discoloration, pain, dryness, cracking of skin, and skin elevation, with the topical application of Rasasindura ointment.
